resources.string: Sign in to back up your data and sync across devices.
Requires Google Play Services, which isn\'t available on this device.
Stops syncing. Local data and your cloud backup are kept.
You can sign back in at any time. Local data and your cloud backup are kept as-is.
Permanently deletes your cloud backup and signs you out of Regimen. Doesn\'t touch data on this device.
This permanently deletes your backup from the cloud and signs you out of Regimen. It does not sign you out of Google or affect any data on this device.
This device can\'t sync automatically while another device is set up as the primary sync device for this account.

This device\'s local data doesn\'t match your cloud backup\'s latest state (this can happen after restoring from a backup). Pull the latest data, or use this device instead if you\'re sure its local data is what you want to keep.
Replace this device\'s data with what\'s in your cloud backup.
